en: A vintage Russian-language postal card with printed heading and address lines. Three orange imperial postage stamps are affixed in the upper-right corner, each canceled with circular postmarks. Another large round postmark is on the left side. The card is filled out in cursive script, and there is a printed note at the bottom stating that only the address should be written on this side.
